existing_selector_integration: Future separately versioned selector receives entry pool and continuation pool separately. Do not filter the sole v1 candidates list or bypass source bindings.
fresh_updates: Not certified by this function. Changed curve/hash/read time alone insufficient; independently validated updated input plus computation/issue/publication/consumption chain and exact native target required in a future reader.
incumbent: separate exact instrument/target/side descriptor; preserve signed remaining move and existing-side continuation even if entry withheld
original_side: sign(original node predicted_signed_pips), verified against original terminal minus reference price
rebased_side: sign(original terminal minus actual decision midpoint)
risk_attachment: Design only: exact instrument/reference price epoch+convention+price and original target/window, explicit side and entry-basis alignment; original full-horizon diagnostics only, never residual-horizon distributions or quantile sums.
scope: Necessary semantic condition only; not confidence, cost, trade eligibility, conditional remaining forecast, execution authorization, or evidence of profitability.
